title: Bundled-function form of finite etale coordinate transition
statement: For every r, α, n and section a, the coordinate transition identity holds as an equality of functions Fin r → Γ(V_n, O).

source.place: Tag 02KG, affine quasi-coherent base change, with its canonical tensor comparison; Tag 0EKP restriction of a finite free embedding.

proof.text: The canonical comparison is bijective on global sections by pullback pasting and the affine structure base-change isomorphism.
Naturality of comparison on the lifted section and bijectivity show that the unique inverse section transports along the base transition.
Apply finite free coordinate naturality to this transported section, then function extensionality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02KG and 01CA; explicit reduction following the original three-step coordinate argument.

affine pushforward base change canonical map natural on global sections

lean.statement:
theorem pushforward_coordinates_transition_fun :
    ∀ (r : ℕ)
      (α : (Modules.pushforward P.obj.hom).obj (Modules.unit P.obj.left) ⟶
        free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Γ(cover f V P (n + 1), ⊤)),
        coordinates f V P α n ((coverTransition f V P n).appTop a) =
          fun i ↦
            (pullback.lift (pullback.fst V.ι (baseMap f n))
              (pullback.snd V.ι (baseMap f n) ≫ baseTransition f n)
              (by rw [Category.assoc, baseTransition_comp_baseMap]
                  exact pullback.condition)).appTop
                (coordinates f V P α (n + 1) a i))
